selection.criterion: Highest validation foreground PSNR; test images not accessed in this selection

appearance_validation.criterion: Highest validation foreground PSNR at fixed 200-step checkpoints
appearance_validation.learned: SH appearance, opacity >=.65, bounded radial offsets and covariance scales; mechanics frozen after training-position fit.

joint_validation.scope: Image gradients through converged equilibrium, frozen learned material decoder, inferred controls, SH appearance. No reference novel-view images.

evaluation.novel_view_limit: No reference images at nonzero angles; no new-view PSNR or accuracy winner claimed.
evaluation.method: Paper NeuralFEM equilibrium adapter with inferred Gaussian attachment targets, fixed learned material decoder, mechanics-bound Gaussian appearance
evaluation.scope: Monocular six-ball geometry prior and position-conditioned reconstruction. Not full coupled transient solver, recovered ground-truth physics, or changed-action forecast.

scope: Existing paper arbitrary-mesh equilibrium adapter with train-inferred Gaussian attachment targets, not the coupled transient Q2 benchmark adapter. Six-object spherical geometry initialization is an added explicit prior.
limitations: Training reconstruction supplies the initial radius/depth gauge; subsequent silhouettes infer position targets.
No measured forces/materials or camera-OOD reference images; no physical-accuracy or novel-view PSNR win is established.
Inferred controls use the full training sequence; temporal interpolation is not future-action forecasting.
No coupled inter-object collision solve in this equilibrium adapter; GPU solver convergence is not evidence of true contact recovery.
